'ProtectSector [%s at %s, %s]: Too fast for us : %s {%s} status: iswreck: %s, isoperational: %s, pilot: %s (%s), distance: not decreasing count: %s, iterations count: %s' .[ this.assignedcontrolled.debugname, this.assignedcontrolled.sector.knownname, this.assignedcontrolled.fleet.name, $target.debugname, $target.class, $target.iswreck, $target.isoperational, @$target.pilot, $target.pilot?, @$targetDistanceToIsNotDecreasing, @$approachingIterationsCount ]

'ProtectSector [%s at %s, %s]: moving to target: %s {%s} at position: %s (%s), distance - %s, acceptable distance - %s, position to target - %s, target size: %s, radius: %s, pos: %s, delta: %s' .[ this.assignedcontrolled.debugname, this.assignedcontrolled.sector.knownname, this.assignedcontrolled.fleet.name, $target.debugname, $target.class, $destination, @$target.relativeposition.{$homeSector}, $targetDistanceTo, $targetOptimalDistanceForAttack, $target.distanceto.[$homeSector, $destination], $target.size, $radius, $targetPos, $target.size / 2 + $radius ]

'ProtectSector [%s at %s, %s]: moving is interrupted by %s : %s {%s} status: iswreck: %s, isoperational: %s, pilot: %s (%s), distance - %s, acceptable distance - %s' .[ this.assignedcontrolled.debugname, this.assignedcontrolled.sector.knownname, this.assignedcontrolled.fleet.name, event.name, $target.debugname, $target.class, $target.iswreck, $target.isoperational, $target.pilot, $target.pilot?, $targetDistanceTo, $targetOptimalDistanceForAttack ]

'ProtectSector [%s at %s, %s]: Run order.fight.attack.object : %s {%s} status: iswreck: %s, isoperational: %s, pilot: %s (%s), distance - %s, acceptable distance - %s' .[ this.assignedcontrolled.debugname, this.assignedcontrolled.sector.knownname, this.assignedcontrolled.fleet.name, $target.debugname, $target.class, $target.iswreck, $target.isoperational, $target.pilot, $target.pilot?, $targetDistanceTo, $targetOptimalDistanceForAttack ]

'ProtectSector [%s at %s, %s]: KUDA AI tweaks detected, applying avoiding code to attack the target: %s {%s} ' .[ this.assignedcontrolled.debugname, this.assignedcontrolled.sector.knownname, this.assignedcontrolled.fleet.name, $target.debugname, $target.class ]

'ProtectSector [%s at %s, %s]: After run order.fight.attack.object : %s {%s} status: iswreck: %s, isoperational: %s, pilot: %s (%s), distance - %s, acceptable distance - %s' .[ this.assignedcontrolled.debugname, this.assignedcontrolled.sector.knownname, this.assignedcontrolled.fleet.name, $target.debugname, $target.class, $target.iswreck, $target.isoperational, $target.pilot, $target.pilot?, $targetDistanceTo, $targetOptimalDistanceForAttack ]

'ProtectSector [%s at %s, %s]: we are not at the target sector %s, but it is blacklisted for travel or activity. Black list ignore: %s. Stopping to work.'.[ this.assignedcontrolled.debugname, this.assignedcontrolled.sector.knownname, this.assignedcontrolled.fleet.name, $homeSector.knownname, $ignoreBlackListsForAttack ]

do_if.value: $ignoreBlackListsForAttack and (this.assignedcontrolled.gatedistance.{$homeSector} lt 0) or not $ignoreBlackListsForAttack and (this.assignedcontrolled.gatedistance.{$homeSector}.{$blacklistGroup}.{this.assignedcontrolled} lt 0)

debug_text.text: 'ProtectSector [%s at %s, %s]: we are not at the target sector %s, but gate distance is negative. Black list ignore: %s. Stopping to work.'.[ this.assignedcontrolled.debugname, this.assignedcontrolled.sector.knownname, this.assignedcontrolled.fleet.name, $homeSector.knownname, $ignoreBlackListsForAttack ]

'ProtectSector [%s at %s, %s]: Jump path with ignored blacklists: %s, count: %s'.[ this.assignedcontrolled.debugname, this.assignedcontrolled.sector.knownname, this.assignedcontrolled.fleet.name, @$jumpPath, @$jumpPath.count ]

'ProtectSector [%s at %s, %s]: Jump path with blacklists: %s, count: %s'.[ this.assignedcontrolled.debugname, this.assignedcontrolled.sector.knownname, this.assignedcontrolled.fleet.name, @$jumpPath, @$jumpPath.count ]

'ProtectSector [%s at %s, %s]: but no jump path found from %s %s to %s %s. Black list ignore: %s. Stopping to work.'. [ this.assignedcontrolled.debugname, this.assignedcontrolled.sector.knownname, this.assignedcontrolled.fleet.name, this.sector.knownname, this.sector, @$homeSector.knownname, $homeSector, $ignoreBlackListsForAttack ]
'jumpPath entry %s: %s %s %s'.[$pathIndex, $jumpPath.{$pathIndex}.class, $jumpPath.{$pathIndex}.knownname, $jumpPath.{$pathIndex}]

'ProtectSector [%s at %s, %s]: We should be at home sector %s, but we are at %s. Resuming flying home.'.[ this.assignedcontrolled.debugname, this.assignedcontrolled.sector.knownname, this.assignedcontrolled.fleet.name, $homeSector.knownname, this.assignedcontrolled.sector.knownname ]

'ProtectSector [%s at %s, %s]: Been flying to home sector for a while, but still not there. Raising fault.'.[ this.assignedcontrolled.debugname, this.assignedcontrolled.sector.knownname, this.assignedcontrolled.fleet.name ]
